value.rationale: Cherry number is a natural tree-shape statistic, while total external length measures the mutation-relevant terminal genealogy. Their exact negative covariance is sample-size invariant despite changing marginal scales, and the stage-resolved negative profile supplies the reason for that invariance. The resulting sharp logarithmic correlation rate adds a structural finite/infinite comparison.
